headline: Committee to review Manchester Arts Commission bylaws, a $200,000 Custom MHT Loan to White Birch Living, LLC, and elderly, disabled, and blind tax exemption increases.
summary: The committee will consider amended bylaws for the Manchester Arts Commission, a $200,000 loan to White Birch Living, LLC, and a recommendation to raise elderly, disabled, and blind exemption benefit amounts.
items: Communication from Jodie Nazaka, Economic Development Director, requesting approval of the amended bylaws for the Manchester Arts Commission.
Communication from Amy Chhom, Chair of the Manchester Development Corporation, requesting approval of a $200,000 Custom MHT Loan to White Birch Living, LLC.

Communication from Charles Kurfehs, Chairman of the Board of Assessors, recommending that the City's elderly, disabled, and blind exemption benefit amounts be increased to align with the City-wide revaluation.
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON ADMINISTRATION/INFORMATION SYSTEMS 
October 20, 2026 at 6:30 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Fajardo, Kantor, Bonilla, Kaw-uh, Sapienza 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Communication from Jodie Nazaka, Economic Development Director, 
requesting approval of the amended bylaws for the Manchester Arts 
Commission. 
Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
2. Communication from Amy Chhom, Chair of the Manchester Development 
Corporation, requesting approval of a $200,000 Custom MHT Loan to White 
Birch Living, LLC. 
Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
3. Communication from Charles Kurfehs, Chairman of the Board of Assessors, 
recommending that the City's elderly, disabled, and blind exemption benefit 
amounts be increased to align with the City-wide revaluation. 
Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
